params.body:
Goes with the pipeline PR that parks a source as muted.

The Sources page treated every scout row (`source-proposed-*`) and journal row (`source-venue-*`) that was off as a proposal. A source the collector had parked came back under "waiting for a yes", and Approve or Approve all switched it on with its failures still counted. That is how Hostelworld stood on at 1040 failures.

Now:
- A scout row is a proposal only while the pipeline reads it as one (`state === 'proposed'`).
- A journal row is a proposal only while nobody has moved it (`stateBy` empty).
- A parked or muted source shows under parked or off, as other sources do.

Tests: `e2e/sources-approve-all.spec.js` now includes a parked scout row and a parked journal row, and Approve all still counts 3. The Sources, navigation and perspective specs pass.
params.title: Sources: a parked or muted source is not offered for approval
